title: Invoicing manager adds a tax: an empty save is refused with a message, a valid save lands in the list

seeds.name: existingTax
seeds.sql: SELECT t.Name AS k FROM Core.Tax AS t WHERE t.Name = '21% (sales)'

seeds.name: taxName
seeds.sql: SELECT 'Journey tax 5% #' + CAST(COUNT(t.ID) + 1 AS STRING) AS n FROM Core.Tax AS t

steps.name: Open Configuration > Taxes and see the seeded taxes
New tax, Save with every field empty: refused, message shown, nothing stored
Fill name, scope, computation, amount and save: the popup closes and the tax is listed

oql.label: the new tax is a 5% sales tax computed as a percentage
oql.sql: SELECT COUNT(t.ID) AS n FROM Core.Tax AS t WHERE t.Name = '{{taxName}}' AND t.Amount = 5 AND t.Scope = 'Sales' AND t.Computation = 'Percentage'

outcome.label: the tax is stored and usable
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(t.ID) AS n FROM Core.Tax AS t WHERE t.Name = '{{taxName}}' AND t.Active = true

_seedNote: Tax names are unique per scope (2026-10-16), so each run names its tax "Journey tax 5% #<n>".
